facts.fact: The Ordem dos Advogados de Angola, the bar association, told the National Assembly president on 27 January 2026 that the cybersecurity bill and the bill against false information threaten free expression and need integral reformulation, citing disproportionate sanctions of 2 to 10 years' prison for executives.
